name: AI-Readable Design System Starter
description: A brand-neutral starter for building a token-based design system in Figma with an LLM, then carrying it into code. Replace the placeholder values; keep the structure.

figma.note: The finished file ships as figma/starter-template.fig; import it into Figma. Two supported paths after that: rebrand the imported file (~22 primitive values; all semantics and variants follow), or create a new empty Figma file and rebuild the same audited contract from this kit.
